name: Route Trainer
author: Skate Rust SDK examples
description: Record your own route: F6 adds a visual checkpoint at your feet; F7 starts a timed run; F8 clears. Visit each checkpoint in order. Routes reset on reload and map change. Cubes have no collision.

radius.label: Checkpoint radius
radius.description: Distance in metres that counts as reaching the next checkpoint.

reset_on_bail.label: Stop run on bail
reset_on_bail.description: Stop timing when the existing physics system enters a bail.
